title: Bootstrap default shade steps and border gray shipped unthemed
evidence: `.btn-primary:hover { background: #0b5ed7; border-color: #0a58ca }` are Bootstrap 5's own 15% and 20% shades of its primary, `#dee2e6` (lines 19, 23) is its $border-color, and the focus ring reuses `#0b5ed7`. Beside the stock `#0d6efd` primary nothing in the file departs from the kit, so it reads as the framework's documentation site. Fix: derive hover, pressed and focus steps from a chosen brand token (`oklch(from var(--primary) calc(l - 0.05) c h)`) and tint the border gray toward the brand hue instead of copying the kit's.

title: Framework default blue as primary at hue 260
evidence: `.navbar` (line 3) and `.btn-primary` (lines 8-9) are filled with `#0d6efd` = oklch(0.578 0.228 260.0): chroma 0.228 at hue 260.0, inside the 255-325 window and 0.2 degrees from Tailwind blue-500 (259.8), the stock blue nobody chose. Fix: a primary outside the arc and 30 degrees or more away, e.g. `oklch(0.58 0.11 205)` deep-cyan or `oklch(0.6 0.15 45)` copper, with the reason for the hue recorded.

title: Secondary note text below AA contrast on white
evidence: `.note { color: #8a8a8a; font-size: 14px; }` on the `#ffffff` body measures 3.45:1 against the 4.5:1 bar for 14px text (rendered at line 24, 'Shipped to every workspace on 14 October.'). Fix: keep the neutral and lower its lightness, e.g. `#6b6b6b` (5.33:1).

title: White button label on ochre fill below AA contrast
evidence: `.btn { background: oklch(0.68 0.14 75); color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; }` measures 2.95:1, and `.btn:hover` at oklch(0.74 0.12 75) drops to 2.34:1, against a 4.5:1 bar. Fix: keep hue 75 and lower lightness to about 0.48 (6.65:1 with white), darkening rather than lightening on hover, or set dark ink on the light ochre.

title: Card meta text below AA contrast on navy card
evidence: `.card .meta { color: #64748b; }` on `.card { background: #0f172a; }` measures 3.75:1 against 4.5:1. Fix: lift lightness on the same slate hue, e.g. `#94a3b8` (6.96:1).

title: Tag text just under the AA contrast bar
evidence: `.tag { background: #f1f5f9; color: #6b7280; }` measures 4.41:1, 0.09 short of 4.5:1: within 0.3 of the bar, so a note rather than a blocker. Fix: `#475569` on the same tint gives 6.92:1.

title: Cream ground, serif display and sage accent together
evidence: All three legs of the tasteful default on one hero: `background: #faf8f5` (line 8), `font-family: 'Instrument Serif'` (line 10) and `#15573a` as both the accent words and the button fill (lines 15, 17), with the empty screenshot card on the right (`.shot`, line 28) that ships with the look. Fix: anchor colour and type to the real brand or a named reference instead of swapping in another tasteful palette; if warm editorial is a stated decision, keep it and mark the line `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`, and put a real product capture in the card.

title: Hero set in a face outside the declared typography
evidence: `.hero { font-family: "Lobster", cursive; }` while the project's DESIGN.md declares `Söhne, system-ui, sans-serif` and states that Söhne is the one face; the body rule at line 9 follows it. Confirmed against DESIGN.md, and not a system-stack fallback. Fix: set the hero in Söhne and carry the display role with size, weight and tracking (`font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em`), or add the second face to DESIGN.md if it is deliberate.

title: Emoji used as status dots, list bullets and button icon
evidence: Seven emoji stand in for interface chrome: `🟢` / `🟡` / `🔴` as state dots in the table (lines 37-39), `✅` and `⚠️` as list markers (43-45), `🚀` inside the deploy button (47). They render differently on every platform and ignore the page's own `--moss` and `--ink` tokens. Fix: small inline SVG marks drawn in token colours with a distinct shape per state beside the existing state word, SVG check and warning marks for the list, and the button label on its own.

title: Fixed pixel shell with no viewport meta
evidence: No `<meta name="viewport">` in the head, `.shell { width: 1200px; }` (line 15), `.lede { width: 640px; }` (17), `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px)` (18) and px-only type (`font-size: 48px`): the page overflows every viewport under 1280px and renders at desktop scale on a phone. Fix: add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, `width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem)`, `max-width: 40rem` on the lede, `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(18rem, 1fr))` for the lanes, and `font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 3.2vw, 3rem)` on the h1 with its -0.025em tracking kept.

title: Middle-dot meta strings on every lane row
evidence: Each of the three lanes prints its facts as an `A · B · C` string ('1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted'; lines 32, 36, 40): three identical instances, six separators. Fix: mark the fields up as a `dl` or list (distance, rate, loads) laid out with a gap or a vertical-rule token, so values align down the lanes and the rate keeps its tabular figures.

title: Flat near-black dashboard with hairline-only boundaries and no accent
evidence: Read from the token map (code-only pass): `--panel` oklch(0.13 0.003 270) on `--ground` oklch(0.12 0.003 270) is a 1.009:1 tint step (floor 1.15:1); the only boundary is `--hair: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08)`, about 1.16 to 1.18:1 against either surface (floor 1.3:1); `--accent` is oklch(0.6 0.02 270), chroma 0.02 against a 0.10 floor, and appears only as text on the current nav link; chroma is reserved for the `.ok` / `.bad` status text; system stack at 400 and 600 only, no elevation. S3 and S4 fail together with S1 and S2. Fix by adding, not removing: derive the ground from a brand hue, raise panels to a perceivable step (about L 0.19) or a solid edge at 1.3:1 or more, give the accent chroma 0.12 or more in two roles with one fill (current-nav marker, a primary action or the key figure), add a hover or overlay level, and widen the weight scale.

title: Focus ring bound to focus, not focus-visible
evidence: Both buttons carry `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600 focus:ring-offset-2` (lines 31, 34) with no `focus-visible:` variant, so a mouse click paints the same ring a keyboard user relies on and the two modes cannot be told apart. Fix: `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2` on both, and the same treatment on the select.

title: Frosted glass sticky navigation bar
evidence: `<nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0">`: the backdrop-blur, translucent white, sticky and bottom-border run, the strongest single-component fingerprint (aliases: Strongest-10 #2 and the section-11 frosted nav). Fix: an opaque surface token with a real bottom edge and a height set by its content; keep the blur only if type has to stay legible over moving content, and decide whether this nav needs to be sticky at all.

title: Saturated purple neon glow on the CTA button
evidence: `.cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); }`: a 40px-blur, 6px-spread halo in purple-500 (oklch 0.627 0.233 303.9, inside the C3 arc) on a light page with no dark-mode need. Fix: carry emphasis with a solid brand fill in a hue outside 255-325 and one step from a tuned elevation scale (e.g. `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 60 / 0.18)`).

title: Focus outline removed with no focus-visible replacement
evidence: `a:focus, button:focus { outline: none; }` and no `:focus-visible` rule anywhere in the stylesheet, so the 'Open the firing schedule' button (line 25) shows no keyboard focus indicator at all (WCAG 2.4.7). Fix: delete the rule and add `a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.45 0.12 60); outline-offset: 2px; }`.

title: Gradient clipped text on the hero headline
evidence: `<h1 class="text-5xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">`: the gradient-text signature, with all three stops inside the AI purple arc (hues 302.3, 322.1, 259.8; aliases C3 and C5). Fix: solid ink for the headline, carried by size and weight across the whole line (`font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1rem + 5vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em`), with one brand hue outside 255-325 reserved for the action.

title: Neutral gray text on saturated blue blocks
evidence: `class="bg-blue-800 text-gray-300"` (line 16) and `.promo { background: #1e40af; color: #d1d5db; }` (line 10): a chroma-0.009 gray on a chroma-0.18 blue. Contrast passes (5.92:1), but the untuned neutral reads dirty against the chromatic field. Fix: tint the text from the surface hue, e.g. `color: oklch(0.9 0.04 265)` or `text-blue-100`.

title: Verbatim Tailwind hero heading class run
evidence: `<h1 class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight">`: the unmodified stepped triplet in its stock order, on a page whose tokens and copy are otherwise tuned (aliases T14, T8). Fix: keep the responsive behaviour and make it fluid, `font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.2rem + 4vw, 3.75rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-weight: 650;`, never a single fixed size.

title: Camera product page with no product imagery
evidence: A page selling a mechanical rangefinder carries 0 `img` / `picture` / `figure` / `video` / `canvas` across 4 sections; every section is the same row of three bordered icon-cards (12 cards, 12 generic 22px line glyphs, lines 35-52) and the header is text plus a button. The floor is one real image per two sections. Fix: a product photograph in the header as the focal visual, and real figures where the copy already describes them (the brass top plate, the finder view with its framelines, the shutter with the back open), keeping icons only where a spec has no picture.

title: Icon-only remove button has no accessible name
evidence: `<button class="remove" type="button"><svg ...><path .../></svg></button>`: the only child is an SVG, with no `aria-label`, no visually hidden text and no `<title>`, so a screen reader announces only 'button' (WCAG 4.1.2). Fix: `aria-label="Delete draft: Re: bench slot for the tenor sax"` on the button and `aria-hidden="true"` on the svg.

title: Cream ground paired with serif display face
evidence: `body { background: #faf8f5; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; }`: two named legs of the tasteful default (the generated cream hex and the listed serif) in one declaration, with Inter as the subtitle face. Fix: anchor ground and type to the real brand or a reference; if warm editorial is a stated decision, mark it `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: Headline is vague workflow hype copy
evidence:
`

Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

`: nothing in it becomes false if a competitor's name is swapped in, while the subtitle below already holds the specific claim. Fix: lead with the concrete verb and object ('Plan the week with your whole team in one place') and support it with a measured outcome.

title: Stock unDraw illustration as the only image
evidence: ``: the brandless flat-vector stock set, hot-linked from the vendor. Fix: a real screenshot of the weekly plan the copy describes, or commissioned illustration in the brand palette.

title: Fixed pixel app shell that cannot resize
evidence: `.app-shell { width: 1180px; height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 260px); }` (lines 3-7): a hard width, an asserted four-column pixel grid, and a `100vh` height that sits under mobile browser chrome (alias P3). Fix: `width: min(100% - 2rem, 74rem); min-height: 100dvh; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));`.

title: Pulsing dot beside the Live label
evidence: `.live-dot { animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }` on an 8px round dot next to 'Live' (lines 13, 27), and a second `animate-ping` `rounded-full` dot after 'Four people are waiting' (line 28). Liveness is ornament here, not content. Fix: let the data carry it, e.g. 'Updated 12 s ago' with the waiting count in an `aria-live="polite"` region, and a static status mark if one is needed.

title: Decorative fuchsia blur blob behind the hero
evidence: `<div class="absolute -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-300 blur-3xl opacity-20">`: the verbatim blur-blob class run, carrying no information. Fix: a real product capture or photograph in the hero, or a committed solid brand field.

title: Welcome back greeting as the hero subhead
evidence: `Welcome back! Pick up where the last sync left off.` is the hero's only line of copy, above a CTA that links to /signup: a returning-user greeting on a page addressed to people with no account. Fix: say what the product does for a first visit, or on a signed-in surface show recognition as data ('Last sync finished 3 hours ago, 2 conflicts to review').

title: Indigo to violet gradient as the primary CTA fill
evidence: `bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-violet-600` on the page's one action: hues 277.1 and 293.0 at chroma 0.23 to 0.25, the centre of the AI purple arc, and the only brand colour on the surface (alias C5). Fix: one solid brand hue outside 255-325 and 30 degrees or more away, e.g. `oklch(0.58 0.16 40)` burnt-orange or `oklch(0.5 0.14 235)` deep-prussian, with hover and pressed derived from it.

title: shadcn demo revenue figure shipped verbatim
evidence: `$45,231.89` with `+20.1% from last month` (lines 23-24) is the shadcn dashboard example's Total revenue card, value and delta unchanged. One card rather than the full stats row, so LOW. Fix: the product's real figure with real comparison context (against target, or the same week last season).

title: Emerald delta text below AA contrast on slate ground
evidence: `text-sm text-emerald-600` (#059669) on the body's `bg-slate-50` (#f8fafc) measures 3.60:1 against 4.5:1 for 14px text; the stock success green was never checked against the surface it sits on. Fix: `text-emerald-700` (#047857, about 5.2:1), and pair the colour with a sign or arrow so direction does not rest on hue alone.

title: Logo marquee loops forever with no pause control
evidence: `.track { animation: scroll 30s linear infinite; }` carrying the row to `translateX(-50%)`, with the three logos duplicated to hide the seam (lines 27-29) and no pause, stop or hover control (WCAG 2.2.2; alias L8). The `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` gate protects only people who asked for less motion. Fix: three logos fit a static row; if the set grows, use `overflow-x: auto` with scroll-snap, or add a visible pause button.

title: Invoice table ships the populated state only
evidence: The table (lines 20-29) is three hard-coded paid rows: no empty state for zero invoices, no error or retry state for a failed load, no loading state behind Refresh, and `.status.paid` is the only status style, so a due or overdue invoice has no treatment. Fix: design the empty state first ('No invoices yet' with the action that creates one), an inline error with retry in an `aria-live` region, a busy state on the button, and due and overdue styles that pair colour with the label.

title: Refresh button handler is an empty TODO
evidence: `<button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button>`: the control is visible and does nothing when pressed. Fix: wire it to the invoice fetch with a busy state and an announced result, or leave it out until it works.

title: JetBrains Mono on stat readouts and table figures
evidence: `font-family:var(--font-mono)` (`"JetBrains Mono"`) on six human-readable readouts: talent-level-value, talent-level-preset, talent-tree-points, talent-points-spent, talent-node-rank and `talent-table td.num` (lines 7-17). Each already sets `font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums`, which is what aligns the digits. The textarea (`white-space:pre`) and the readonly input hold raw strings and may keep mono. Fix: `font-family:var(--font-sans)` on those six selectors, keeping tabular-nums and the 600 emphasis weight.

title: Bounce motion on toast, menu and scroll cue
evidence: Three bounce reflexes on one page: `.toast { animation: bounce-in 600ms both; }` whose keyframes reverse direction four times (0, -24px, 0, -10px, 0; lines 18-24) on an order confirmation, `.menu` easing with `cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)`, which both anticipates and overshoots (line 16), and `animate-bounce` on the arrow cue (line 35). Fix: match energy to the message: the status toast rises once on `transform` and `opacity` (200ms ease-out), the menu settles once (`cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)`, 180ms), and the cue stays still; keep the reduced-motion gating.

title: Near-identical heavy padding on every section
evidence: All three sections share the `mx-auto max-w-4xl px-6` shell at `py-20`, `py-20` and `py-24` (lines 13, 18, 25): 160 to 192px of vertical padding around a heading plus one control, unrelated to content density. Fix: set padding by content, e.g. `padding-block: clamp(3rem, 2rem + 4vw, 6rem)` for the hero and `clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 2vw, 3rem)` for the two single-action sections, or merge those two into one.

title: Three explanatory paragraphs dropped between tiles and table
evidence: Lines 34-36 are three `p` elements whose parent is `main`, with no heading over them, sitting between the tile grid and the invoice table: 3 orphans, 114 words, the longest 63 words (threshold: two orphans, or one over 60). Fix: give each a home: the refresh note becomes a caption under the tiles, and the collections and credit-netting rules move into the headed 'How balances are calculated' section below the table, at a 45 to 75ch measure.

title: Three consecutive text-only sections close the page
evidence: 'How balances are calculated', 'Payment terms' and 'Who to contact' (lines 45-55) each hold one h2 and two paragraphs and nothing else: a run of 3 sections with no list, table, figure or control. Fix: give at least every second one a non-text device the content already implies: payment terms as a `dl` (net 30, daily fee accrual, where enterprise terms live), contacts as a list with the inbox and team links.

title: Grid, dot and stripe patterns behind content
evidence: Three decorative pattern fields: a fixed hairline grid on `body::before` (two 1px linear-gradients on a 24px tile, lines 13-14), a dot field behind the hero (`radial-gradient(circle, ... 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 16px 16px`, line 18) and 45-degree stripes behind the promo (`repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, ... 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px)`, line 19). None encodes anything. Fix: a solid tinted surface per section with one real edge, and the week's five releases as a list or figure for the hero's visual.

title: Gradient clipped accent word in the hero headline
evidence: `.accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; color: transparent; }` applied to the single word 'reconciled' in the h1 (line 28), with no stated-decision marker; it is also the one accented headline word (alias T15). The rest of the page is tuned and draws no finding. Fix: set the whole headline in the ink colour and let the GT Sectra weight and size carry it, keeping the terracotta for the link.

title: Four-paragraph introduction above the drop table
evidence: Primary content taken as the 'Drop sources' table (line 47). Running prose above it: the 27-word lede plus four 'About' paragraphs of 75, 63, 60 and 56 words (lines 40-43), 281 words against the 40-word lede budget for a reference page. The identity block and lede are right as they are. Fix: move the table directly under the identity block, and place the About material (mechanics, methodology, the drop-rate caveat, enchant history) below it as headed subsections or behind `details` whose summary names its content ('How these figures are filtered'); no facts deleted.

title: Saturated cyan radial halo behind the hero
evidence: `.hero { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8), transparent 70%); }` on a `#0b0b10` page: the CSS form of the decorative blur blob, a 0.8-alpha cyan stop fading to transparent behind the section. Fix: a solid raised surface derived from the ground hue with a top-edge rim, or atmosphere held under about 0.05 alpha, with the rota itself as the hero's content.

title: Hero heading tracked tight enough for letters to collide
evidence: `.hero h1 { font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: -0.1em; }`: tighter than the -0.07em defect floor, 3.2px pulled out of every letter gap at this size. Fix: `letter-spacing: -0.02em`.

title: Article body leading set at 1.15
evidence: `.article p { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.15; }` on a 50-word paragraph: under the 1.3 floor for running text. Fix: `line-height: 1.5` (1.4 to 1.6).

title: Mixed-case note paragraph tracked at 0.12em
evidence: `.note p { letter-spacing: 0.12em; }` on a 28-word mixed-case sentence: wider than the 0.05em limit for running text; open tracking belongs on short capitalised labels. Fix: drop the tracking (0 to 0.01em) and separate the note by weight, colour or a rule.

title: Justified text in a 22ch sidebar column
evidence: `.sidebar-note { width: 22ch; text-align: justify; }` with no `hyphens: auto`: a column well under 45 characters, so justification opens rivers between words. Fix: `text-align: start`, or widen the note to its natural measure.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card class run
evidence: `<div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the library's Card primitive verbatim, demo padding included, with no token or class changed. Fix: recompose for this surface with the project's own radius and border tokens, a background step instead of `shadow-sm` for a resting panel, and padding set by the content (e.g. `rounded-[var(--r-panel)] border border-[var(--edge)] bg-[var(--raised)] p-4`).

title: Border, shadow and radius trio repeated on both cards
evidence: The second card is `shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4`, so both cards on the surface (lines 6 and 10) carry the same unexamined border + `shadow-sm` + radius treatment, with the stock `shadow-sm` to `shadow-md` hover step. Fix: commit the trio instead of deleting it: one stated radius, a border colour that measures against both surfaces, and elevation that differs by panel role (resting panel edge only; raised or interactive panel a tuned shadow step).

title: shadcn init token values shipped untouched
evidence: The `:root` block (lines 8-20) is the current `shadcn init` neutral scaffold verbatim: `--radius: 0.625rem`, `--background: oklch(1 0 0)`, `--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)`, `--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)`, `--border` and `--input: oklch(0.922 0 0)`, `--ring: oklch(0.708 0 0)`. Every value is achromatic; OKLCH is the generator's notation, not a tuned theme. Fix: make the first hue decision, e.g. `--primary: oklch(0.58 0.16 40)`, derive hover, soft and border states with relative colour syntax, tint background and foreground toward the brand temperature, and choose a radius identity.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card around plan usage
evidence: `<div class="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the verbatim current-generation Card class run with the demo `p-6`. A separate span from the token block: one untouched Card is still a Card nobody made a decision about. Fix: recompose once the tokens are themed (an edge plus a background step, content-sized padding) and show 42 of 100 seats as a meter rather than a sentence.

title: Coloured side stripe on five callouts
evidence: The same accent-edge ornament in five syntaxes: `.tip { border-left: 4px solid ... }` (line 11), `.quote { border-inline-start: 3px solid ... }` (12), the `.feature::before` 4px bar (14), `.panel { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 ... }` (15) and `rounded-xl border-l-4 border-teal-600` (25), in five hues that encode nothing (no severity, selection or category). Fix: one callout treatment that stands on its own: a full 1px border on a tinted surface with a leading label or icon naming the note's kind, and the quote set by indent and italic.

title: Heading level jumps from h2 to h4
evidence:
`

Refund timing

` follows `

Sending an item back

` with no h3, and `h4 { font-size: 1.25rem; }` shows the level was picked for its size; heading navigation in a screen reader reports a missing level. Fix: `

Refund timing

` with `h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; }`.

title: Page view transition runs for 650ms
evidence: `::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root) { animation-duration: 650ms; }` on every navigation between the three sibling routes, over the 400ms ceiling for a full-page change, so each switch feels stalled. The no-preference gating is correct and stays. Fix: `animation-duration: 220ms` (200 to 300ms) with an ease-out curve.

title: Save button and hint bypass the defined tokens
evidence: The file defines `--brand: oklch(0.49 0.085 158)`, `--space-100/200/300` (4/8/12px) and `--radius: 6px`, then `.save` uses `background: oklch(0.543 0.104 159)`, `padding: 11px 17px`, `border-radius: 5px` and a third green on hover, `oklch(0.5 0.11 160)` (lines 24-30); `.hint` adds `margin-top: 9px` (line 31). Three near-identical greens and spacing that misses the scale by 1px. Fix: `background: var(--brand); padding: var(--space-300) calc(var(--space-200) * 2); border-radius: var(--radius);`, hover as `oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h)`, and `margin-top: var(--space-200)`.

title: Article paragraph set at 11px
evidence: `.article p { font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }` on a 43-word paragraph of renewal terms: running text under the 12px floor, in px units that ignore the reader's font-size setting. Fix: `font-size: 1rem` (0.9375rem at the least).

title: Price note in running text set at 10px
evidence: `.price-note { font-size: 0.625rem; }` (10px) on 'Taxes added at checkout.' inside the lead paragraph: running text under the 12px floor. Fix: `font-size: 0.875rem` in a secondary colour, or move it to a footnote in a legal footer, where the 10px floor applies.

title: Footer navigation links set at 10px
evidence: `.footer-nav a { font-size: 10px; }` on the Terms and Privacy links: functional text under the 11px floor, which also shrinks the tap target. Fix: `font-size: 0.8125rem` with `padding-block: 0.5rem`.

title: Default 8px radius on every form control
evidence: `border-radius: 8px` on `input, select, textarea` (line 21), `.chip` (25) and `button.submit` (27): five control types, one value, the pre-v4 shadcn `--radius` default, written three times with no token. Fix: commit a radius identity in tokens, e.g. `--r-control: 3px; --r-chip: 999px;`, so fields and the submit share the precise corner and the chips read as a different kind of control.

title: Pill radius applied to every control, textarea included
evidence: `rounded-full` on the text input (line 28), the select (33), the three-row textarea (41), the status chip (45) and the submit button (48): one radius on five controls, applied mechanically (a pill-shaped multi-line textarea crowds its own first and last lines into the curve). Fix: keep the pill for the chip, where it reads as a tag, and give the fields and the button a committed small radius such as `rounded-sm`.

title: 100vh app shell with fixed bottom action bar
evidence: `.app { height: 100vh; }` (line 16) plus `.bar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }` (lines 21-22) with no `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` and no `viewport-fit=cover`: on mobile the shell is measured against the largest viewport, the bar sits on the home indicator, and it covers the last stop because the scroller reserves no space for it. Fix: `height: 100dvh`, make the bar a flex child rather than fixed (or pad the scroller by its height), and `padding-bottom: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` with `viewport-fit=cover` in the viewport meta.

title: Firing card laid out by a viewport media query
evidence: `@media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } }` restyles a component that renders in both the 14 to 18rem `.rail` (line 40) and the wide `.main` column (lines 46, 50): past 60rem the rail copy gets a 9rem label column inside about 14rem. Fix: `.rail, .main { container-type: inline-size; }` and `@container (min-width: 28rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; column-gap: 1.5rem; align-items: baseline; } }`.

title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom
evidence: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">` blocks zoom for low-vision users (WCAG 1.4.4). Fix: `content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"`.

title: Positive tabindex reorders the search form
evidence: `tabindex="3"` on the query input, `1` and `2` on the two date inputs and `4` on the submit button (lines 18-26): focus starts on 'Issued after', skips the header link, and reaches the first field third. Fix: remove all four attributes; the DOM order is already the right order.
